# S0.2 — hand-authored `react/minimal` throwaway baseline: one headless coding task end-to-end

Implements ticket **S0.2** (`docs/tickets/002_S0.2__hand-authored-baseline.md`), Stage-0 build
chain row 2 of 106. Stacks on S0.1 (base `svitali/harnessharness-s0.1`).

## Summary
A hand-authored `react/minimal` definition runs one headless coding task end-to-end through a
deliberately minimal **throwaway** C0 subset (doc 3 §11.0; §9.1): hand-stamped
provenance/identity, one root `BudgetNode`, a **model-blind gateway over one wire dialect with a
scripted offline stub** (never a live model), one in-process tool executor, a single-file trace
(not the ledger), a deny-by-default allow-list (not the reference monitor), one static role,
stdio `hello`, and the headless CLI driver. It is kept only as a de-risking baseline and is
**deleted at the Stage-0 boundary** — nothing persistent depends on it.

No claim about any harness is made at Stage 0.

## What changed
- **New throwaway crate `crates/hh-baseline`** (workspace member, ADR-0221; NOT a dependency of
  the kernel). Reuses S0.1's `hh-wire` (canonical JSON, framing) and `hh-embed-schema`
  (`hello`/`ContractIdentity`) — never re-establishing them (CC7). Pure std otherwise; offline.
  - `provenance.rs` — hand-stamped `principal`/`definition`/`external` authority classes (R-2.1.5).
  - `hir.rs` — hand-authored `react/minimal` HIR/1 document with `validate` only (R-2.1.2/R-2.6.1).
  - `budget.rs` — one root `BudgetNode`, hard ceilings on `tokens.blended`/`model_calls`/`time.wall_ms`, `check`, `budget_exhausted{dimension}` (R-2.1.6).
  - `gateway.rs` — model-blind gateway, one-entry static `ModelRoleTable`, `model.route.decided`, offline `StubModel` (R-2.3.1/R-2.3.2⁰).
  - `secrets.rs` + `env.rs` — deny-by-default allow-list, known-value masking, `leak_scan`, `local_host` `EnvHandle` (`isolation_class=none`, honest), `declared→ready→torn_down` (R-2.8.3/R-2.2.5).
  - `tools.rs` — one in-process `tool_executor` for shell + fs, sandbox-escape denial, timeout-with-kill, output masking (R-2.5.5).
  - `context.rs` — `default` policy, six reserved slots, `context.assembled{context_label}`, `ContextWindowExceeded→stop` (R-2.4.1).
  - `trace.rs` — single-file M1/M3/M7 trace, `trace_view`/`cost_view`/`compact_view` + loss report (R-2.9.1).
  - `control.rs` — the `react/minimal` loop + driver-subset envelope (ceilings, transport retry, tool timeout, parse refusal) (R-2.6.1/R-2.6.2).
  - `driver.rs` + `bin/hh-baseline.rs` — headless CLI: `run start/events/status`, `definition validate`, `version`, `doctor`, `hello`; `human`/`jsonl`+`result`; stdout/stderr split; `unattended`+`unattended_deny`; `MissingBudget`; five exit classes (R-2.11.1⁰ᵃ); stdio `hello` reuse (R-2.11.4⁰ᵃ).
  - `tests/end_to_end.rs`, `tests/cli.rs` — the deterministic acceptance tests.
- **`Cargo.toml`** — adds `crates/hh-baseline` to workspace members with a throwaway note.
- **Build memory** — `docs/adr/ADR-0221`, `ADR-0222` (+ regenerated `docs/adr/README.md`);
  `docs/tickets/DEFERRALS.md` row DF-S0.2-1; `docs/build/runs/S0.2.md`; this PR body.

## Design decisions (ADRs)
- **ADR-0221** — the baseline is a workspace-member crate (so its ACs run under `cargo test
  --workspace`) rather than an out-of-workspace `spikes/` tree; deleted whole at the boundary.
- **ADR-0222** — the Stage-0 exit-class mapping (`StopReason → {ok, invocation_error,
  validation_error, infrastructure_failure, budget_exhausted}`) and interim exit-code numerals
  (MUST-data under OQ-384/OQ-470; ADR-0212). A property test asserts the map is total.

## Verification
- `cargo test --workspace` → **84 green** (S0.1: 26; hh-baseline: 58 = 42 unit + 10 cli + 6 e2e).
- `cargo fmt --all --check` clean; `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets` no warnings.
- `bash scripts/check-drift.sh` → in sync (single schema source untouched — CC7).
- Live release CLI (`HH_BASELINE_HOME=<tmp>`, `stdin=/dev/null`): version/doctor/hello ok; one
  headless coding task completes in 3 turns (writes+reads a file through the sandboxed executor);
  `run start --jsonl` minus its final `result` line **diffs empty** against `run events --from 0`;
  compact view ships a loss report; `MissingBudget`→exit 2; `budget_exhausted{model_calls}`→exit 5;
  blank task→exit 3; `grep` finds **0** secret leaks in produced output.
